entities.summary: Pirro Gonzaga (1505–1529) was a Roman Catholic cardinal. He was the third son of Ludovico, who was the second Count of Rodigo with Rivalta, and Lord of Sabbioneta, Correggioverde, Pomponesco, Gazzuolo, and Belforte; and of Francesca, the daughter of Gian Luigi Fieschi, Count of Lavagna. He was a cousin of Cardinal Ercole Gonzaga.
